sources: Kobak et al., 'Delving into LLM-assisted writing in biomedical publications through excess vocabulary', 2024/2025

rules.hint: Em dash in prose; end the sentence or use a comma.
En dash or hyphen standing in for an em dash.
Curly quote or apostrophe; use straight quotes unless the format requires curly.
Arrow in prose; write the relationship as words.
ASCII arrow in prose; write the relationship as words.
Decorative emoji; remove from headings, bullets, and prose.
Colon joining two clauses; keep colons only before lists, examples, or quotations.
Chat shorthand in prose; spell it out.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:additionally|bolster(?:s|ed|ing)?|crucial(?:ly)?|delv(?:e|es|ed|ing)|deep dive|enduring|foster(?:s|ed|ing)?|garner(?:s|ed|ing)?|interplay|intricate(?:ly)?|intricacies|meticulous(?:ly)?|pivotal|showcas(?:e|es|ed|ing)|tapestr(?:y|ies)|testament|underscor(?:ed|ing)|underscores? (?:the|its|his|her|their|a|an|how|that|why|our)|vibrant|realm|multifaceted|commendable|invaluable|paramount|holistic(?:ally)?|synerg(?:y|ies|istic)|ever-(?:evolving|changing)|everchanging|embark(?:s|ed|ing)?|bustling|nestled|kaleidoscope|symphony|moreover|furthermore|notably|resonat(?:e|es|ed|ing) with|align(?:s|ed)? with|in the realm of|in today's (?:digital|fast-paced) (?:age|world))(?!\w)
rules.hint: AI vocabulary; name the action or property meant (phrases.md).
Often AI vocabulary; keep only the literal or technical sense.
Promotional language; state the checkable fact instead (tropes.md).
Magic adverb giving a vague air of significance; say what happens.
Adverb propping up a claim; use a stronger verb or the number.
Possible stand-in for 'is' or 'has'; keep it when the verb is literal.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:serv(?:es|ed|ing) as|stands? as|stood as|boast(?:s|ed|ing)?|features (?:a|an)|ventured into|began (?:his|her|their|its) career as|took on the role of|rose to prominence|holds the (?:distinction|position|title) of|made (?:his|her|their|its) mark|carved out a)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Fancy stand-in for 'is' or 'has'.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:utili[sz](?:e|es|ed|ing|ation)|leverag(?:e|es|ed|ing)|facilitat(?:e|es|ed|ing)|numerous|commenc(?:e|es|ed|ing)|endeavou?r(?:s)?|ascertain(?:s|ed)?|plethora|myriad|a (?:wide|diverse) (?:range|variety|array) of|in order to|due to the fact that|at this point in time|in the event that|has the ability to|conduct an? \w+ation|when it comes to|moving forward|going forward|at the end of the day|prior to)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Filler or inflated word; use the plain version (phrases.md table).
Metaphor noun; use the concrete word unless it is the technical term.
Possible metaphor noun; keep it only as the established technical term.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:a testament to|(?:is|as) a (?:reminder|testament)|(?:pivotal|key|crucial|defining) moment|(?:key |major )?turning point|evolving landscape|focal point|indelible mark|deeply rooted|setting the stage for|paving the way (?:for|to)|(?:marks|represents|signals) a (?:shift|new era)|reflects? (?:a )?broader|broader (?:trends?|movement|implications)|plays? an? (?:crucial|pivotal|vital|key|significant|important|central) role|cannot be overstated|more (?:important|relevant) than ever|a new era|(?:a |an )?(?:significant|major|big|giant|important|huge) (?:step|leap) forward)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Inflated significance; state the specific fact or cut it (tropes.md).
Trailing -ing analysis; say what the clause claims or cut it (structures.md).

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:experts? (?:say|says|argue|argues|believe|agree|suggest|note)|industry (?:reports|experts|observers)|observers (?:have )?(?:noted|cited|argued)|(?:some|many) (?:critics|observers|analysts|scholars) (?:argue|say|believe|note)|studies (?:show|suggest|have shown)|research (?:shows|suggests)|it is widely (?:believed|recognized|acknowledged|regarded)|(?:is|are) widely (?:regarded|considered|seen) as|many (?:people )?(?:believe|argue|say|feel) that|according to (?:some|many|several)|described in scholarship|several (?:sources|publications|reports))(?!\w)
rules.hint: Vague attribution; name the source or cut the claim (tropes.md).

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:independent coverage|(?:local|regional|national|international) media outlets?|trade publications|(?:has been|have been|was|were) (?:featured|profiled|cited) in|active social media presence|garnered (?:significant |widespread )?attention|received (?:widespread|critical) acclaim)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Canned notability claim; cite the fact, not the coverage.
Vague connection; state the actual relationship.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:as of my (?:last )?(?:knowledge|training) (?:cutoff|update)|up to my last (?:training|knowledge) update|while (?:specific )?details are (?:limited|scarce)|not widely (?:available|documented|disclosed|known)|based on (?:the )?available information|in the (?:provided|available) (?:sources|search results))(?!\w)
rules.hint: Knowledge-limit disclaimer or speculation about gaps; keep unknowns unknown (tropes.md).

rules.pattern: \bnot (?:just|only|merely|simply|about)\b[^.!?\n]{1,80}?(?:\bbut\b|[,;—] ?(?:it's|it is|they're|this is|that's)\b)|\b(?:isn't|is not|wasn't|was not|aren't|are not|doesn't|don't)\b[^.!?\n]{1,60}[.;,—] (?:It's|it's|It is|it is|They're|they're|This is|this is|That's|that's)\b
rules.hint: Negative parallelism; state the positive claim unless the exclusion is a contract.
'Not X. Not Y. Just Z.' reveal.
'The X? A Y.' setup; state it directly.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:here'?s (?:the thing|the kicker|the catch|the deal|the truth|the problem|what|why|how)|let'?s (?:dive|delve|break (?:this|it) down|unpack|explore|take a (?:closer )?look|talk about)|let me (?:break|walk you through|explain)|quick note|it'?s worth (?:noting|mentioning|pointing out)|worth noting|(?:it is|it's) (?:important|critical|crucial|essential) to (?:note|remember|consider|understand|recognize)|importantly,|interestingly,|needless to say|it goes without saying|that said,|with that in mind)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Announcement before the point; cut it (phrases.md).

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:full stop|let that sink in|make no mistake|honestly\?|real talk|and yes,|let'?s be honest|to be (?:honest|frank|fair)|i'?ll be honest|this is not a rant|hot take|spoiler(?: alert)?:?)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Manufactured emphasis or candor (phrases.md).

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:i want to be (?:clear|exact|precise|honest|explicit)|to be clear|i should (?:be clear|note|mention|point out)|let me be (?:clear|honest|precise)|worth being precise about|i'?ll (?:now )?(?:start|begin) by|first,? i'?ll|now,? let'?s)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Narration of the writer's process; do the thing instead.
Count announced before the list; let the list stand.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:to answer your question|to bring it back|so,? to (?:answer|summari[sz]e|recap)|in short,|long story short|the bottom line(?: is)?|tl;?dr)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Tie-back restating the answer.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:in (?:summary|conclusion|closing)|to (?:sum up|summari[sz]e|conclude|wrap up)|all in all|overall,|ultimately,|as we'?ve seen|in this (?:article|post|section),? we(?:'ll| will))(?!\w)
rules.hint: Signposted summary or roadmap; end with the last useful content.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:despite (?:its|these|their|the|such) [^.\n]{0,40}challenges|faces? (?:several |many |numerous |significant )?challenges|challenges and (?:opportunities|future directions|legacy)|future (?:outlook|prospects|directions)|the future (?:looks|is) (?:bright|promising)|only time will tell|remains to be seen|exciting times ahead)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Formulaic challenges-and-outlook ending; state actual plans or facts.
Stock analogy or 'imagine' opener; keep only if it clarifies (structures.md).
'From X to Y' that may not be a real range; list the items.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:could potentially|may potentially|might potentially|might possibly|could possibly|it could be argued|it can be argued|arguably|to some extent|in some ways|somewhat)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Stacked or empty hedge; keep one real qualifier.
'Where it actually lives' framing; name the place.
Passive voice with a named actor; make the actor the subject unless the object matters more.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:whether you'?re (?:a |an )?[\w -]{1,40} or|at (?:its|their) core|in essence|the key takeaways?|the (?:reality|truth) is|let'?s face it|shed(?:s|ding)? (?:some |new )?light on|a stark reminder|at the intersection of|the power of|harness(?:es|ing)? the power|unlock(?:s|ing)? the (?:full )?potential|(?:a )?delicate balance|treasure trove|(?:a )?beacon of|meticulously crafted|without further ado|buckle up|in a world where|simply put|dive (?:deeper|into)|navigat(?:e|es|ing) the complexit(?:y|ies)|look no further|take (?:it|your [\w-]+) to the next level|the best of both worlds|a wealth of|rapidly (?:evolving|changing)|fast-paced|say goodbye to|stands? the test of time|a force to be reckoned with|(?:plays|played) (?:a )?(?:crucial|pivotal) part)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Stock phrase; say the specific thing (phrases.md).

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:essentially|in other words|sheer|embrac(?:e|es|ed|ing)|stands? out|crafted|curated|what'?s more|not to mention|feel free to|commitment to|whether it'?s|stark contrast|a deep understanding)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Often a stock phrase; keep only if it carries meaning.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:production[- ]ready|enterprise[- ]grade|battle[- ]tested|blazing(?:ly)?[- ]fast|lightning[- ]fast|rock[- ]solid|bulletproof|fully (?:functional|featured|tested)|industry[- ]standard|robust and scalable|highly scalable|comprehensive (?:test suite|solution|guide|overview|set of|coverage)|key features:?|summary of changes|follows? (?:industry )?best practices|clean(?:er)? and maintainable|maintainable and scalable|elegant solution|world[- ]class)(?!\w)
rules.hint: Hype in technical writing; state the measured property or cut it.
Change summary that says 'improved' without saying what changed; name the change.
'This commit adds' framing; start with the change itself.
Comment narrates the edit history; describe the code as it is now (structures.md).
Step-by-step narration in a comment; keep only non-obvious reasons.
Comment paraphrases the code; keep only what the code cannot say.

rules.pattern: (?<!\w)(?:i hope this helps|hope this helps|of course!|certainly!|absolutely!|great question|you'?re (?:absolutely |totally )?right|would you like me to|is there anything else|let me know if|happy to help|i'?d be happy to|here is (?:a|the) (?:more )?(?:detailed )?(?:breakdown|summary|overview)|found (?:it|the (?:smoking gun|culprit|issue))!|as an ai|as a (?:large )?language model|i'?m sorry,? but|i cannot (?:provide|offer|help))(?!\w)
rules.hint: Chatbot phrase; remove from standalone writing.
Chatbot citation or markup artifact; remove and cite properly.
Unfilled template placeholder.

checks.hint: Title Case heading; use sentence case.
Conclusion, summary, or outlook section; end with the last useful content instead.
'Topic: A Subtitle' heading; one plain label is enough.
Heading holds only subheadings and no text.
Bold label the line then restates; convert to prose (structures.md).
Run of bullets that all start with bold labels; keep only if they name fields.
Three or more bold spans in one line; bold only what readers must not miss.
Horizontal rules between sections; headings already separate them.
Over 40 words; split if the reader must reread.
Three or more very short sentences in a row; connect them unless it is narrative.
Three sentences in a row open with the same words.
'The first... The second... The third...' prose; use a list or connect the points.
